metadata.title: Tesla Stock Rises Again. SpaceX and 1 Other Thing Driving It Higher.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Tesla Stock Heads for Third Day of Gains. It’s About More Than SpaceX.
Tesla stock was up again early Wednesday, trying to extend recent big gains. Investors are feeling better about something. It’s hard to say what that is.
